name: Asure AI Story Deck
tagline: The studio’s AI story, split into procedure and closing.

page.objective: Tell the studio’s AI story as a procedure someone can follow, not a list of capabilities.
page.problem: One long deck mixed the how-it-works narrative with the ask, and neither landed.
page.solution: Two standalone decks: a seventeen-slide procedure story and a three-slide action and closing.
